title: Wright-Patterson as reverse-engineering site for enemy equipment

tellings.quote: Wright Pat was the place that the military would take enemy equipment in order to reverse engineer it.

plain: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio is said to have been the place where, from the 1940s on, the US military brought captured enemy machines so its engineers could take them apart and work out how to copy them. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in his interview with David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has said the government holds craft that were not made by humans. The point is that if the military ever recovered such a craft, this base would be the natural place for it to end up.
